entities.name: RlmN
observations: The 382-residue query sequence matches reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa RlmN proteins at 89.5% identity with approximately 100% coverage and E-values near 1e-251.
RlmN is a dual-specificity radical SAM RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenine N2 at position 2503 of 23S rRNA and position 37 of tRNAs.
RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).

entities.name: RlmN rRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 2503 in 23S rRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine (m2A2503), using two SAM molecules and radical-SAM electron-transfer chemistry; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the mapped reaction representation.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA methylation
observations: Adenosine at position 37 in tRNA is converted to 2-methyladenosine (m2A37), using two SAM molecules and radical-SAM electron-transfer chemistry; products include 5'-deoxyadenosine, methionine, and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the mapped reaction representation.

entities.name: RlmN [4Fe-4S] cofactor
observations: RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteine residues; the cluster supports radical SAM chemistry with an exchangeable SAM ligand.
